description: Email fraud & deliverability check. Validates an email address, detects disposable/temporary addresses, flags emails seen in data leaks, and returns a 0-100 fraud score plus deliverability, SMTP, and DNS validity signals. Example: check_email({ email: "user@example.com" }) Requires your own IPQualityScore API key, passed as _apiKey.

_apiKey.description: Your own IPQualityScore API key (BYO — Pipeworx does not supply one). Free tier at ipqualityscore.com; the key is on the account dashboard.

name: check_email
